# Atal Bihari Vajpayee Memorial Tournament
> The premier annual invitational cricket championship of Vindhya Pradesh, sanctioned by the Rewa Division Cricket Association (RDCA) and affiliated with the Madhya Pradesh Cricket Association (MPCA).

## Primary Documentation
- [Tournament Home](https://abv-rewacricket.pages.dev/)
- [The Derby Teams](https://abv-rewacricket.pages.dev/teams/)
- [Match Archive (34 Matches)](https://abv-rewacricket.pages.dev/matches/)
- [Official Regulations (14 Codes)](https://abv-rewacricket.pages.dev/rules/)
- [Governing Council](https://abv-rewacricket.pages.dev/governing-council/)
- [News & Media Releases](https://abv-rewacricket.pages.dev/news/)
- [Contact & Venues](https://abv-rewacricket.pages.dev/contact/)
